title_en: We are selling an apartment 1+1+ Balcony in Rugen e Kosovareve!
description_en: We are selling an apartment 1+1+ Balcony in Rrugen e Kosovareve. The apartment is located on the 4th and last floor of an existing building. It has a net area of 62m2. It is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchen with access to the balcony, a bedroom and a bathroom. The apartment has undergone a total restoration, there is an investment such as AC4 parquet, new electrical line, multi-way hydraulic works, double-glazed windows. Price 165,000 euros Possibility of purchase with credit For a visit to the property, contact me.
